reports.title: Linea Cross-Chain Governance Executor
reports.description: Consensys Diligence review of the LineaBridgeExecutor contract (built on Aave's cross-chain governance bridge executors, intended for Lido governance of wstETH on Linea) and its IMessageService interface in Consensys/governance-crosschain-bridges at commit 7d4fd35. Only a NatSpec recommendation was reported and remediated in commit 315308a.

reports.title: Linea Bridge Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin audit of the Linea V1 ZkEvmV2 rollup, L1/L2 message services with rate limiter and pause manager, and the canonical TokenBridge in Consensys/linea-contracts at commit f08c190, with fixes reviewed in Consensys/linea-contracts-fix. One Critical (token bridge reentrancy) and three High issues were reported, of which the Critical and one High were resolved.

reports.title: Linea Verifier Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin audit of the gnark-generated PLONK verifier contracts PlonkVerifierFull and PlonkVerifierFullLarge in Consensys/linea-contracts-fix at commit 04d6677, with fixes reviewed in per-issue pull requests. A Critical proof-forgery issue (challenge u not bound to the opening proofs) was found and resolved in PR #30.

reports.title: Linea V2 Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin audit of the Linea V2 rollup and message service contracts (LineaRollup compressed data submission and finalization, rolling hashes, sparse Merkle tree messaging) at commit bb6eb72 with fixes at 99039eb. Both commits are only in the private Consensys/linea-contracts-audit repository and are not served by any public repository.

reports.title: Linea Blob Submission Audit
reports.description: Diff audit of the Linea rollup and message-service changes that add EIP-4844 blob data submission (submitBlobData) and remove obsolete V1 code. No high or critical issues were found; the final reviewed code was replicated to the public linea-contracts repository.

reports.title: Linea Gas Optimizations Audit
reports.description: Diff audit of Linea rollup, message service and token bridge gas optimizations (transient storage reentrancy guard and message sender, deprecated rollup storage replaced by summary state, multi-blob submission), plus a token bridge event change PR. One High issue (finalized state root hash not bound to the finalized shnarf) was found and resolved.

reports.title: Linea Audit Report (Cyfrin, v2.0)
reports.description: Manual review of the Linea L1/L2 message service, token bridge and rollup contracts focused on blob submission/finalization gas optimizations, deprecation of old messaging storage and transient-storage use. Two High findings (deprecated message sender breaking TokenBridge completion for old messages, one-way ERC721 bridging) were fixed and the mitigations merged into the public linea-contracts repository.

reports.title: Linea Plonk Prover (Backend) and Plonk Verifier Audit
reports.description: Audit of gnark's BN254 PLONK prover, Go verifier and proof (un)marshalling used by Linea, plus the changes to the Solidity verifier template generator. One High issue (quotient polynomial shards not individually blinded, breaking statistical zero knowledge) was resolved via an optional StatisticalZK mode.

reports.title: Audit of Linea Wizard's crypto/ & math/
reports.description: Three-week review of the Linea prover's math/ (BLS12-377 field, FFT, smartvectors) and crypto/ (Keccak, MiMC, RingSIS, sparse Merkle tree and accumulator, Vortex) libraries, finding only Low and Informational issues. The scope was the then-private zkEVM monorepo and the report identifies no repository URL, commit, tag or branch, so no audited revision is accessible.

reports.title: Linea Rollup Update
reports.description: Review of the Linea contract updates between Alpha v2 and Alpha v3.2: EIP-4844 blob submission, rollup and message service gas optimizations, and minor token bridge changes. Only two Minor findings were reported, both acknowledged.

reports.title: Linea zkEVM (crypto-beta-v1) Security Audit Report
reports.description: Audit of Linea's zkEVM prover (crypto-beta-v1): the Wizard protocol compiler and verifier, zkEVM constraint modules (ECDSA, ECPair, public input, state manager), execution/aggregation/blob-decompression circuits and backend, the compress library, and gnark EVM-precompile circuits and frontend. Several Critical and High soundness issues (verifier accepting any permutation query, missing activation, zeroization and leaf-hash constraints, non-boolean Select condition) were found and resolved by the verification review.

reports.title: Linea Rollup and TokenBridge Role Upgrade
reports.description: Diff audit of the Linea rollup, message service and TokenBridge contracts between the contract-audit-2024-05-24 and contract-freeze-2024-11-01 tags, covering removal of block numbers from submissions, state-reconstruction events and a granular role/pause permission model. The most severe finding was a Medium fallback-operator denial of service; all issues were resolved.

reports.title: Linea Audit Report (v2.2)
reports.description: Audit of new developments in the Linea rollup, message service and token bridge contracts, including granular role-based access control, blob submission and finalization refactoring, the fallback operator, TokenBridge storage changes and optimized hashing. Fixes, additional commits and OpenZeppelin fix PRs were reviewed up to the final commit tagged contract-audit-2025-01-06.

reports.title: Limitless Prover Security Audit Report - Linea zkEVM
reports.description: Audit of the Linea zkEVM Limitless (distributed) Prover: the distributed prover implementation, the grand product, Horner, log-derivative sum, projection and Plonk-in-Wizard queries and compilers, recursion and dedicated columns. A verification review of the suggested fixes was performed at a later revision.

reports.title: Linea TGE Audit
reports.description: Audit of the LINEA token generation event contracts (L1 LineaToken, L2LineaToken and TokenAirdrop with their interfaces) in the private Consensys/linea-tokens repository, including PRs 10 and 11 and a final review of all fixes. The report confirms the in-scope files match contracts-tge/src in the public linea-monorepo at tag contract-audit-2025-07-30.

reports.title: Linea Tokens Audit Report (v2.5)
reports.description: Audit of the LINEA L1 and L2 token contracts and the TokenAirdrop contract in the private Consensys/linea-tokens repository, with validation of the final merge commit including fixes from concurrent audits. The report verifies that the code later moved to contracts-tge in the public linea-monorepo matches the final commit.

reports.title: Linea - Burn Mechanism
reports.description: Audit of the Linea revenue burn mechanism: the L2 RollupRevenueVault (invoice payment, ETH burn and LINEA buy-and-bridge), the V3DexSwap adapter and the L1LineaTokenBurner, with their interfaces. Fixes were reviewed up to the final commit tagged contract-audit-2025-10-30.

reports.title: Linea Burn Mechanism Audit Report (v2.2)
reports.description: Audit of the Linea burn mechanism contracts RollupRevenueVault, L1LineaTokenBurner and V3DexSwap with their interfaces. Fixes were verified up to the fix commit 77b83d2 and the release tag contract-audit-2025-10-30.

reports.title: Linea Burn Mechanism Audit
reports.description: Audit of the Linea burn mechanism contracts: RollupRevenueVault, L1LineaTokenBurner and the V3DexSwap adapter with their interfaces. Fixes were reviewed up to a final commit, and later changes to in-scope files in the contract-audit-2025-10-30 commit were also reviewed.

reports.title: Linea Yield Manager Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin audit of the new Linea yield management system (YieldManager, LidoStVaultYieldProvider, ValidatorContainerProofVerifier, LineaRollupYieldExtension and supporting libraries) at 4360e31, plus a diff review of the LineaRollup/LineaRollupBase upgrades since contract-audit-2025-01-06. Fixes were reviewed through PR 1879 and the combined-fix PR 1965, with 9c16ce3 as the final commit reviewed.

major_finding_ids: Duplicate Validator Requests DoS Permissionless Unstaking

reports.title: Linea Mixed Upgrade Audit Report
reports.description: Cyfrin incremental audit at 78f9d1fa of a mix of Linea contract changes: dynamic chain variables, the contracts folder restructure and TokenBridge refactor, transient storage and security-council pause changes, and the data availability modularization of LineaRollup. The Critical TokenBridge storage-layout issue was fixed in PR 2007; mitigations were reviewed up to fix commit c374a2c9 and the deployed bytecode was matched at 698d8830.

reports.title: Linea Forced Transactions Audit Report
reports.description: Cyfrin audit at 990f688 of the Linea forced transaction changes of PR 897 (ForcedTransactionGateway, AddressFilter, FinalizedStateHashing and related LineaRollup, LineaRollupBase and LivenessRecovery changes), with fixes at 053093da. No Critical/High/Medium issues were found; four bytecode verifications (70dde76, 4ddbeba, 6d0c5d4 and mainnet) followed.

reports.title: Linea Yield Manager Audit Report
reports.description: Cyfrin audit at 4360e31 of the Linea yield management system (YieldManager, LidoStVaultYieldProvider and factory, ValidatorContainerProofVerifier, LineaRollupYieldExtension) and the related changes to L1MessageService, MessageHashing, LineaRollup and LineaRollupBase, including a review of other auditors' mitigations. Mitigations were merged at 9c16ce3, bytecode was verified at 25e323d, and the v2.1 addendum reviews the PR 3654 fix merged at 82af194.

reports.title: Linea Canonical Token Bridge
reports.description: Consensys Diligence review of Linea's canonical ERC-20 TokenBridge and BridgedToken contracts in the private Consensys/linea-token-bridge repository at commit db5553a, with per-issue fix PRs. A second round reviewed the token address collision fix in the public Consensys/linea-contracts-fix PR #3.

reports.title: Linea Message Service
reports.description: Consensys Diligence review of Linea's L1/L2 message service, rate limiter, pause manager, RLP/transaction decoding libraries and the ZkEvmV2 rollup contract at zkevm-monorepo commit 8ccf247 (served by the public linea monorepo). No fix review is included in the report.

reports.title: Linea Plonk Verifier
reports.description: Consensys Diligence best-effort review, with partial Dafny formal verification, of the gnark-generated PLONK verifier with the BSB22 commitment custom gate (Verifier.sol and Utils.sol) in Consensys/plonk-solidity-audit at commit b3533f2. Several Critical and Major soundness and validation issues were reported; no fix commits are given.

reports.title: Linea Custom Bridged Token
reports.description: Consensys Diligence one-day review of the CustomBridgedToken contract, a BridgedToken variant whose ownership can be handed to the token issuer (such as Lido's wstETH handed to LineaBridgeExecutor), in Consensys/linea-contracts at commit 3cf8552. No issues were found.

reports.title: Linea Contracts Update
reports.description: Consensys Diligence review of the Linea V2 contract update (compressed data submission and finalization in LineaRollup, L1/L2 rolling hashes, sparse Merkle tree L2 to L1 messaging) and of fixes to OpenZeppelin's V2 findings. The entire scope (commits 0154676, a4fb9a4, bb6eb72 and 075b26e) is in the private Consensys/linea-contracts-audit repository and is not served by any public repository.

reports.title: Linea Rollup Update
reports.description: Diff audit of the Linea rollup, message service and token bridge contracts between the previous audit commit and a new monorepo commit, covering granular roles, state-reconstruction-compatible events, the fallback operator and removal of finalization without proof. Fixes were reviewed up to the contract-audit-2025-01-06 tag.

reports.title: Linea Token and Airdrop Contracts
reports.description: Audit of the LINEA token contracts on L1 and L2 (supply sync over the message service, L2 voting) and the TokenAirdrop contract in the private Consensys/linea-tokens repository, with fix review up to the final commit. The report confirms the final code is identical to contracts-tge/src in the public linea-monorepo at tag contract-audit-2025-07-30.

reports.title: Linea - Yield Manager
reports.description: Consensys Diligence review of the Linea native yield system (YieldManager, LidoStVaultYieldProvider and its factory, LineaRollupYieldExtension, pause managers, MessageHashing and helper libraries) that stakes L1 bridge reserve ETH via Lido v3 stVaults. Fixes were verified at 25e323d, with later bytecode confirmations for the main-branch merge 9c16ce3 and the PR 3654 yield message sender fix (82af194).

reports.title: Linea Poseidon2
reports.description: Consensys Diligence review of the Poseidon2 hash and sparse Merkle proof verification contracts (Poseidon2.sol, SparseMerkleProof.sol, one line of LineaProofHelper.sol) used for L1 verification of Linea L2 state proofs and cross-chain ENS resolution. The scoped repository Consensys/linea-apps-monorepo and all referenced commits are not publicly accessible.

reports.title: Linea Forced Transactions
reports.description: Consensys Diligence review of the Linea forced transactions mechanism (ForcedTransactionGateway, AddressFilter, FinalizedStateHashing and the forced-transaction parts of LineaRollup, LineaRollupBase and LivenessRecovery) at 990f688 as guided by PR 897. No major issues were found; later updates confirm bytecode reproducibility at 70dde76, 4ddbeba and 6d0c5d4 and the matching mainnet deployment.

reports.title: Linea Rollup Update
reports.description: Consensys Diligence multi-phase differential review of the Linea L1/L2 contracts from contract-audit-2025-01-06 (a83412e) to the yield integration milestone 9c16ce3, covering the contracts folder restructure, pause expiry/cooldown, inheritance and transient-storage changes, dynamic chain configuration and data availability modularization. Fixes were verified at 08622461, whose bytecode was matched to the deployed LineaRollup, TokenBridge and L2MessageService, with an April 2026 check of the PauseManager/YieldManager integration at a45bf64.
